record.title: Propose one documented SCPI identity query without executing it
record.intent: Prepare an identity-only checkpoint after recorder verification and stop for operator review.
requirements: Inspect and pin the official MHO900 programming guide; verify exact IDN query semantics, response fields, terminator and documented LAN SCPI endpoint, separating documentation from live behavior.

Propose fresh verified capture before isolated host address assignment, no gateway/DNS/NAT/forwarding/external route, exactly one IDN query to the documented endpoint, raw request/response preservation and a stop for firmware-corpus reconciliation.
Address lease currency, host-originated traffic, recorder failure and unexpected network behavior as explicit gates. Do not silently renew a lease or broaden the request.

No physical acquisition or host address change in this proposal task. No options query, Web Control, ADB, scans, USB, authentication or scope configuration change. Commit and push findings; do not admit execution tasks.
acceptance: A concrete evidence-backed B1 proposal is ready for operator review without instrument access.
